## User journey

Who needs this, and what observable outcome should they get?

## Current gap

What happens with the current code? Link the relevant command, guide, or specification.

## Proof and boundaries

How would we know the journey works? Note compatibility, security, cost, or recovery concerns.

## Possible approach

Optional. A problem statement is enough to start the discussion.
